title: AMLR CDD Policy Builder
description: Build a Customer Due Diligence (CDD) policy framework per AMLR (Reg (EU) 2024/1624). Configures SDD, standard CDD, and EDD tiers with required measures. Applies 10 Jul 2027.

mcp_tool_definition.name: amlr_cdd_policy_builder
mcp_tool_definition.description: Build a Customer Due Diligence policy framework per AMLR (Reg (EU) 2024/1624) Art. 20–29. Outputs SDD/CDD/EDD tier assignments. Browser-based, zero PII.
